  requires (t != 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (t > 0)) or (result == (bal + t)))

  effects pure
  example (step(0, 10) == 10)
  example (step(5, -3) == 2)
  example (step(2, -20) == 2)
  example (step(0, 5) == 5)
{

}

fn walk(acc: Int, xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires ((acc >= 0) and (forall x in xs: (x != 0)))

  ensures (result <= (acc + (sum x in xs: if (x > 0) then x else 0)))

  example (walk(0, []) == 0)

}

fn keep_parity(xs: List[Int], want_even: Bool) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) <= len(xs))
  ensures forall x in result: (((x % 2) == 0) == want_even)
  effects pure
  example (keep_parity([1, 2, 3, 4], true) == [2, 4])
  example (keep_parity([1, 2, 3, 4], false) == [1, 3])
  example (keep_parity([], true) == [])
  example (keep_parity([-2, -3], true) == [-2])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (((h % 2) == 0) == want_even) then ([h] ++ keep_parity(t, want_even)) else keep_parity(t, want_even) }
}

fn evens_first(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): contains(result, xs[i])
  ensures ((sum x in result: x) == (sum x in xs: x))
  effects pure
  example (evens_first([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [2, 4, 1, 3])
  example (evens_first([5, 7]) == [5, 7])
  example (evens_first([]) == [])
  example (evens_first([-2, -3]) == [-2, -3])
{
  (keep_parity(xs, true) ++ keep_parity(xs, false))
}

fn has(xs: List[Int], n: Int) -> Bool
  requires forall x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, n))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 2], 2) == true)
  example (has([1, 2], 3) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == n) or has(t, n)) }
}

fn search(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 1)
  requires forall x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures (result >= k)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in k..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (search([1, 2, 4], 1) == 3)
  example (search([2], 1) == 1)
  example (search([1, 2, 3], 2) == 4)
  example (search([], 1) == 1)
{
  if has(xs, k) then search(xs, (k + 1)) else k
}

fn first_missing(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures (result > 0)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in 1..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (first_missing([1, 2, 4]) == 3)
  example (first_missing([3, 5]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([1, 2, 3]) == 4)
{
  search(xs, 1)
}

fn interleave(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == (2 * len(xs)))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): ((result[(2 * i)] == xs[i]) and (result[((2 * i) + 1)] == ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (interleave([1, 2, 3], [7, 8, 9]) == [1, 7, 2, 8, 3, 9])
  example (interleave([], []) == [])
  example (interleave([5], [6]) == [5, 6])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [g, ..s] => ([h, g] ++ interleave(t, s)) _ => [] } }
}

  requires ((n >= 2) and (d >= 2))
  ensures (result == (exists k in d..n: (((k * k) <= n) and ((n % k) == 0))))

  example (has_divisor(9, 2) == true)

{
  if ((d * d) > n) then false else if ((n % d) == 0) then true else has_divisor(n, (d + 1))
}

  requires (n >= 2)

  example (is_prime(9) == false)
  example (is_prime(13) == true)
  example (is_prime(15) == false)
  example (is_prime(97) == true)
{
  not has_divisor(n, 2)
}

fn min2(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a != b)
  ensures ((result <= a) and (result <= b))
  ensures ((result == a) or (result == b))
  effects pure
  example (min2(3, 5) == 3)
  example (min2(5, 3) == 3)
{
  if (a <= b) then a else b
}

fn min_of(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires ((len(xs) >= 1) and distinct(xs))
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall x in xs: (result <= x)
  effects pure
  example (min_of([7, 2, 9, 4]) == 2)
  example (min_of([5]) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => match t { [] => h [_, ..u] => min2(h, min_of(t)) } }
}

fn remove_min(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires ((len(xs) >= 1) and distinct(xs))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - 1))
  ensures distinct(result)
  ensures forall x in result: contains(xs, x)
  ensures forall x in xs: (contains(result, x) or (x == min_of(xs)))
  effects pure
  example (remove_min([7, 2, 9, 4]) == [7, 9, 4])
  example (remove_min([5]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match t { [] => [] [_, ..u] => if (h == min_of(xs)) then t else ([h] ++ remove_min(t)) } }
}

fn kth_smallest(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires ((distinct(xs) and (k >= 1)) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures ((count x in xs: (x < result)) == (k - 1))
  effects pure
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == 2)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 3) == 7)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 4) == 9)
  example (kth_smallest([5], 1) == 5)
{
  if (k == 1) then min_of(xs) else kth_smallest(remove_min(xs), (k - 1))
}

  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])

  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => drop(t, (k - 1)) }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result <= len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] == v)
  ensures ((result == len(xs)) or (xs[result] != v))
  effects pure
  example (run_of([1, 1, 2], 1) == 2)
  example (run_of([], 5) == 0)
  example (run_of([3], 3) == 1)
  example (run_of([1, 2], 2) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == v) then (1 + run_of(t, v)) else 0 }
}

  effects pure

  example (max2(4, 4) == 4)
{
  if (a >= b) then a else b
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result <= len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): (run_of(drop(xs, i), xs[i]) <= result)
  ensures ((result == 0) or (exists i in 0..len(xs): (result == run_of(drop(xs, i), xs[i]))))

  example (longest_any([7]) == 1)

  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => max2(run_of(xs, h), longest_any(t)) }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)

  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => gap_from(h, t) }
}

fn count_lt(xs: List[Int], c: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == (count y in xs: (y < c)))
  effects pure
  example (count_lt([5, 1, 3], 4) == 2)
  example (count_lt([], 4) == 0)
  example (count_lt([2, 2, 9], 2) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => ((if (h < c) then 1 else 0) + count_lt(t, c)) }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (len_of([5, 1, 3]) == 3)

  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => (1 + len_of(t)) }
}

fn select_rank(cands: List[Int], xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  requires forall c in cands: contains(xs, c)
  requires exists c in cands: ((count y in xs: (y < c)) == k)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures ((count y in xs: (y < result)) == k)
  effects pure
  example (select_rank([5, 1, 3], [5, 1, 3], 1) == 3)
  example (select_rank([8], [8], 0) == 8)
{
  match cands { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (count_lt(xs, h) == k) then h else select_rank(t, xs, k) }

{
  select_rank(xs, xs, ((len_of(xs) - 1) / 2))
}

fn merge_sorted(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires sorted(xs)
  requires sorted(ys)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures sorted(result)
  ensures forall x in xs: contains(result, x)
  ensures forall y in ys: contains(result, y)
  effects pure
  example (merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 9])
  example (merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([5, 6], []) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([], []) == [])
  example (merge_sorted([2], [1]) == [1, 2])
{
  match xs { [] => ys [x, ..xt] => match ys { [] => xs [y, ..yt] => if (x <= y) then ([x] ++ merge_sorted(xt, ys)) else ([y] ++ merge_sorted(xs, yt)) } }
}

fn rot_take(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == k)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (rot_take([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) == [1, 2])
  example (rot_take([1, 2, 3], 0) == [])
  example (rot_take([1, 2, 3], 3) == [1, 2, 3])
{
  if (k == 0) then [] else match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ rot_take(t, (k - 1))) }
}

fn rot_drop(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  effects pure
  example (rot_drop([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4])
  example (rot_drop([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 2, 3])
  example (rot_drop([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => rot_drop(t, (k - 1)) }
}

fn rotate_left(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures (result == (rot_drop(xs, k) ++ rot_take(xs, k)))
  effects pure
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4, 1])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [4, 1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([], 0) == [])
{
  (rot_drop(xs, k) ++ rot_take(xs, k))
}

  ensures ((result == None) == (len(xs) == 0))
  ensures ((exists x in xs: ((result == Some(x)) and (forall y in xs: (y <= x)))) or (result == None))
  effects pure
  example (max_of([]) == None)
  example (max_of([3, 9, 1]) == Some(9))
  example (max_of([4]) == Some(4))
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => match max_of(t) { None => Some(h) Some(m) => if (h > h) then Some(h) else Some(m) } }
}

  requires distinct(xs)
  requires contains(xs, m)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - 1))
  ensures not contains(result, m)
  ensures forall x in result: contains(xs, x)

  example (drop_value([5, 2, 8, 1], 8) == [5, 2, 1])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h == m) then t else ([h] ++ drop_value(t, m)) }
